 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 6068/2023 Mukesh Kumar S/o Banwari Lal, Aged About 30 Years, R/o Kikraliya Rawatsar Hanumangarh Raj.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Chimana Ram S/o Amar Singh, R/o Biharipura Bas Ward  No. 02 Bhadra Dist. Hanumangarh Raj.

----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Achala Ram For Respondent(s) : Mr. Shrawan Bishnoi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 19/10/2023 The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. have been filed by the petitioner for quashing of FIR No.308/2023 registered at Police Station Bhadra, District Hanumangarh for offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the material available on record, I am not inclined to quash the FIR.

However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to file representation alongwith relevant documents before the concerned Superintendent of Police and concerned Investigating Officer within a period of fifteen days.

The concerned Superintendent of Police and concerned Investigating Officer shall take up all the facts as well as representation, if any,
filed on behalf of the petitioner and complete the investigation by [2023:RJ-JD:36056] (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-6068/2023] considering them strictly in accordance with law within a period of one month from the date of filing of the representation.
In the meanwhile and for a period of four weeks, the petitioner shall not be arrested.
The instant misc. petition filed by the petitioner is disposed of accordingly.
Stay petition is also disposed of.
